label: TP
reason: Both alerts are true positives. Alert 1 (java/xss): User-controlled data from request.getHeader("Referer") flows through URLDecoder.decode() to bar, then to response.getWriter().format() at line 59. The "Z" append in the conditional does not sanitize XSS payloads. Alert 2 (java/tainted-format-string): Same flow - bar (derived from user-supplied Referer header) is used as the format string argument, allowing attackers to inject format specifiers. Resolved sink value in both cases is attacker-controlled (Referer header content).

evidence.note: User input from request.getHeader("Referer") flows through URLDecoder.decode() to bar variable, which is then used unsanitized in response.getWriter().format() at line 59. The conditional appending "Z" does not mitigate XSS or format string injection.
